Remedy control (`safety-remedy-controls-epyc-20261108T151055-39c3ef8e`, VERIFIED, exact ddb7199d source, temporary edit restored byte-for-byte): replacing `(count * N).div_ceil(128)` with `count.div_ceil(128 / N)` turns the red probe green. Vec's existing capacity check rejects the impossible count before a Packed exists. No other library change was made. This is a validation of the proposed remedy, not a landed fix; ordinary-size behavior and timing were not re-gated by this control.

— Sam Shackleton
